title: All Unity games in the October Triple-i Initiative
summary: Discover new releases Blue Prince and Thronglets, as well as the Unity game news coming out of the Triple-i Initiative showcase.
body_markdown:
*[Machinarium 2](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619280/Machinarium_2/)* (Amanita Design) – world premiere of the sequel to the 2009 classic, wishlist on Steam now


[Pony Island 2: Panda Circus](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017940/Pony_Island_2_Panda_Circus/) (Daniel Mullins Games) – playtest live now on Steam


[PRISON OF HUSKS](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2975260/PRISON_OF_HUSKS/) (Glass Head Dolls / Wings) – launching January 27, 2027 on PC and PS5, Steam demo out now


*[Prospice: Anomalous Logistics](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4067370/Prospice_Anomalous_Logistics/)* (Code Wakers / Forklift Interactive) – demo available now, launching in 2027


[ReVamp](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295000/ReVamp/) (Digital Sun Games/ Forklift Interactive) – release date set for March 25, 2027, playtest sign-ups live on Steam
